sentences.en: Sami didn't know he was getting involved in a cult.
sentences.zh: 萨米不知道自己卷入了一个邪教。

sentences.en: Sami considers Layla an enemy because she left his cult.
sentences.zh: 萨米认为莱拉是他的敌人，因为她离开了他的邪教组织。

sentences.en: A cult classic spaghetti western was playing at the theater.
sentences.zh: 电影院正在放映一部邪教经典意大利西部片。

senses.zh: 异教，异教组织；狂热崇拜，迷信；（特定群体的）偶像，时尚；崇拜者，信徒；宗教信仰，宗教习俗
